name: camouflage
flavor_text: The user’s type is changed depending on its environment, such as at water’s edge, in grass, or in a cave.
effect_text_extend:
User’s type changes according to the terrain.

Terrain        | New type
-------------- | --------------
Building       | Normal
Cave           | Rock
Desert         | Ground
Grass          | Grass
Mountain       | Rock
Ocean          | Water
Pond           | Water
Road           | Ground
Snow           | Ice
Tall grass     | Grass

In Pokémon Battle Revolution:

Terrain        | New type
-------------- | --------------
Courtyard      | Normal
Crystal        | Rock
Gateway        | Water
Magma          | Rock
Main Street    | Normal
Neon           | Normal
Stargazer      | Rock
Sunny Park     | Grass
Sunset         | Ground
Waterfall      | Grass
effect_text_simple: User’s type changes to match the terrain.
